invalidity_findings: decisive-v1.1 candidate views were nearly case-invariant and did not provide usable case-specific diagnosis evidence
historical observations exposed pass/fail and digests but no causal component
all five agentic historical predictions were BOUNDED_INCONCLUSIVE, including a semantic abstention
static and agentic lanes received unequal evidence
evaluator labels and reference data were in the same package environment
deterministic opaque IDs were derivable from public case IDs
historical experiment requests reused precomputed A/B observations
safety reruns could be served from a cache
full production-source coverage excluded executable modules
v1_2_corrections: candidate-visible T-cut evidence is separate from evaluator-only labels and provenance
historical and safety episodes use one strict candidate-evidence schema and generic record IDs
episode IDs are cryptographically random per run and mapped only by the evaluator
the evaluator owns the stateful experiment loop, ledger, executor calls, and complete-output gate
experiment requests validate parameters before case lookup and reruns are always fresh
candidate Docker construction is digest-pinned, network-denied, read-only, non-root, and capability-dropped
corrected labels distinguish terminal state, candidate causality, root cause eligibility, owner eligibility, and semantic intent
candidate-only information sufficiency remains blocked until a blinded solvability reference exists
artifact catalogs and historical runtime recipes are separately verified by exact digests
reference comparison binds suite, evidence, labels, runtime, baseline, executor, protocol, platform, predictions, metrics, and decision
